name: main-production-protection
description: Production branch protection: prevent accidental deletion and force push, require signatures, require one code-owner approval, and require the `ci-required` aggregate status check with a strict up-to-date policy. Only that single aggregate is ever required: shards, jobs and scanners are inputs to it, so renaming one internally is not a branch-protection change. For pull requests `ci-required` is published solely by the publish-ci-required job in .github/workflows/ci-authoritative.yml, which is triggered by workflow_run and therefore executes default-branch code that can read SONAR_TOKEN; ci.yml runs untrusted PR code and must never publish it. Before adding a context here, confirm that publisher exists and has been seen succeeding — a required context nothing can emit blocks every pull request. backend/tests/ci/test_ruleset_workflow_contract.py enforces the reachability and self-consistency of this file.
